title: incremental.config.json
description: Repository configuration file for incremental, located at the repo root.

exclude.description: Globs matched against canonical (realpath) paths only.

ignore.description: Paths to ignore (P11) - dropped from changes, listed in ignored.

globalInputs.description: Any change triggers fallback (global_input) - affects everything.

fallbackContextKeys.description: Context keys that trigger fallback if changed (plus reserved keys always checked).
